IMPORTANT: This is a template. Copy and customize for your production environment.
SECURITY_NOTES: 1. NEVER commit production secrets to source control
2. Use Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or environment variables for sensitive data
3. Remove this IMPORTANT and SECURITY_NOTES section after configuration
4. Review all connection strings and ensure they use secure credentials

REQUIRED: Configure proper signing certificate (not developer certificate)
Enable KeyManagement or implement secure key storage
Store keys in Azure Key Vault or similar secure storage
Use SQL migration scripts with proper deployment pipeline
Configure connection string resilience and retry policies
Set up database backup and disaster recovery
Migrate from Implicit Flow to Authorization Code Flow with PKCE
Configure proper redirect URIs for production
